messages:
ops-jen: heads-up: getting a bunch of 503s hitting /payments from multiple regions. incident-bot did NOT page oncall. noticed a bunch of 'suppressor: matched' in the notify logs. @oncall-alex are you seeing anything?

sre-marc: seeing the 503 spike in dashboards, ~2k reqs/min at 01:02 UTC. Alerts fired but incident-bot posted a small summary and then a 'suppressed' note. :thinking:

incident-bot: automated: Detected 503 spike for service=payments, severity=sev2. Suppression rule: routing_key=payments-intake matched suppressor group 'maintenance-windows'. No page sent. (id=inc-1847770000)

oncall-alex: I did not get paged. I'm on rotation and my pager shows nothing. I can join if needed.

ops-jen: short term — manual ringdown starting. @eng-sam @platform-lee can you confirm whether this is a real suppression or a false positive from signing header rotation?

eng-sam: checking webhook receiver logs now. There's a new header `X-Notify-Claim` that switched formats during a deploy 01:00 UTC. Our suppressor regex expects numeric tenant id; new format is prefixed with 'v2:'. That would make the suppressor think these are in maintenance. Repro logs:

```
incoming webhook headers:
  X-Notify-Claim: v2:payments:tenant-42
  X-Signature: sha256=...
```

sre-marc: ah — suppressor rule is `^payments:\d+$` so 'v2:' breaks parsing logic and defaults to 'unknown' group which was configured to auto-suppress. Ugh.

platform-lee: quick mitigation: change suppressor fallback to not auto-suppress unknown, and re-evaluate recent webhooks. I'll push a toggle to disable suppression for the payments route. Patching now.

incident-bot: automated: suppression policy updated by platform-lee, fallback=alert (no suppress). Will re-evaluate incoming events.

ops-jen: manual page: calling list for payments. @oncall-alex pinged via SMS and voice. Please confirm you have the bridge.

oncall-alex: called in, on the bridge. Joining now. :phone:

eng-sam: rolling back the header format in the receiver to previous stable schema to avoid further misclassification. Deploy rollback started: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/pay-notify-receiver` (pod restart expected ~30s)

product-maya: customers: we're seeing increased error-rate on checkout flows. Customer support flagged tickets and one enterprise tenant reported failed payments. Need impact summary for postmortem.

ops-jen: live mitigation checklist: 1) suppression toggle (done) 2) manual page (done) 3) rollback header change (in progress) 4) validate no missed pages for the last 30m -> will run search in notify logs

sre-marc: confirm: after toggle, incident-bot re-evaluated 42 events and created 3 follow-up pages. We have oncall in bridge.

incident-bot: automated: Created follow-up incident inc-1847770001 for payments: 3 pages issued.

eng-sam: rollback complete, receiver pods healthy. Reprocessing backlog now (replays starting). I see reduced 503s immediately.

platform-lee: changed suppressor default in configmap to 'no-auto-suppress' for unknown groups and added stricter parsing. Pushing to staging then prod.

ops-jen: customer impact: partial outage for checkout (15-25% error rate) between 01:00-01:15 UTC for some regions. Enterprise tenant acme-corp reported 30 failed charges. Need to coordinate customer comms with support.

product-maya: noted. I'll draft a status update and coordinate with trust/security for sensitive customers.

oncall-alex: adding low-latency remediation: temporary rate-limit bypass for retries to reduce failed payments for queued jobs.

sre-marc: postmortem action items (high-level): 1) tighten suppressor parsing and tests (eng) 2) add schema validation for X-Notify-Claim header (eng) 3) incident-bot: alert if suppression fires for >N matching events in 1m (platform) 4) run chaos/kitchen tests on header changes (SRE+Eng) 5) customer comms template (product/support)

ops-jen: thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread open for final impact numbers. For now, page closed once metrics back to baseline and customer tickets triaged. :white_check_mark:

eng-sam: quick log snippet for the rollback confirmation:
```
[01:04:12] receiver v1.2.3 started
[01:04:14] processed webhook id=abc123 status=200
[01:04:30] replayed 200 events -> reduce 503s
```

sre-marc: metrics baseline restored at 01:08 UTC. Marking incident as mitigated. We'll kick off postmortem doc and link here.

ops-jen: incident resolved. next steps: postmortem + add unit/integration tests for suppressor. Closing thread in 2h after doc link.

incident-bot: automated: Incident inc-1847770000 marked mitigated by ops-jen (01:08 UTC).
